information.name: ucrm-oidc
information.description: Sign in to existing UISP and CRM staff accounts with OpenID Connect. The provider handles OIDC authentication; native permissions and session lifetimes are retained. Native password login retains its authenticator requirement.
information.author: Centre WISP

configuration.label: Enable OpenID Connect login
configuration.description: Configure the identity provider and client secret in the provider settings below. Save login availability and the execution schedule separately. Native password login remains available.
